title: Tensor equalizer for a Hopf-stable subalgebra
statement: Let k be a field, H a commutative Hopf k-algebra, and K a k-subalgebra such that Δ(K) lies in the k-linear span of tensors with both factors in K and S(K)⊆K. Give H its K-module structure by inclusion. For every x∈H, the equality x⊗_K1=1⊗_Kx in H⊗_K H implies x∈K.
lean_statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] (K : Subalgebra k H) (hΔ : (∀ x ∈ K, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k H H | ∃ a ∈ K, ∃ b ∈ K, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a b})) (hS : (∀ x ∈ K, HopfAlgebra.antipode k x ∈ K)) (x : H), (TensorProduct.tmul K x (1 : H) : TensorProduct K H H) = TensorProduct.tmul K (1 : H) x → x ∈ K
